title: It would be nice to have a 2000.5 and a 2003 .5 :/

posts.author: ZENWARECO
posts.body:
Kind of a strange question, considering not too many people even RM2k or RM2k3 as much (still activity but...)... ...
I kinda remember sometime ago, there was an RPG Maker 2009.  Is it good?  I was wishing for like a 2000.5 and a 2000.3, though the most obvious answer is to use the newer ones.  It's the nostalgia here that I like though, that's why.
I guess what I'm wishing (though it's been done by now) is note tags in skills. :/  But that's done already, VX up. Or a skill that is a normal skill when used, though would activate a switch in battle, not just a switch skill, but with all the normal functions. :/  I was trying to get battle messages - though taken care by Cherry. Then the amount of skills and items. What only 9999?
Then with battle events...ONLY 100 pages? What is this?? I was trying to get more things going on in battles, at least picture wise.  More If's and Thens, and more conditions.   Maybe some more things in states that states could do.  So limiting. 9999 animations? Switches? More use of terms, maybe multiple messages for misses like in 2000.  That was already "done" by Cherry, thanks! 9999 common events?
Limitations are so much fun! No!! I want to be an RM2k3mon master!! Though needing and wanting an engine that's "better" why am I stuck on these. That's the most obvious answer.
Though it's time here - time. And I have work, etc. Things that might be kinda nice. I sure wish so.

posts.author: Trihan
posts.body: I think you may be slightly confused. There was never an "official" RPG Maker 2009. rm2k9 is a patch for 2k and 2k3 that Cherry created, and basically *is* the 2000.5 and 2000.3 you're saying you want.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
The forum itself doesn't focus on Maniacs, But that doesn't stop anyone from explaining to you whether it's possible or not.
Stating that Maniacs can be used for something isn't the same as creating a thread teaching step-by-step how to do it.
Another thing:
I've seen Discord servers focused on RM2003 and Maniacs mentioned here more than once as an alternative to your requests. The fact is, as I always say, you seem to either misunderstand or
conveniently ignore this
.
ZENWARECO said:
Then with battle events...ONLY 100 pages? What is this??
Click to expand...
The limit exists for a reason, but you yourself have mentioned several times that you know how to use ResHacker and don't need help with this kind of thing, which leads me to question:
Why you didn't modify Rm2k3 yourself to change those limits
?
I'm not saying it will work in all situations
, there's a good chance you'll exceed the
memory
limit due to the space limitations of each
address pointer
.
However, nothing, absolutely nothing, prevents you from making these modifications yourself. What's not allowed is asking third parties to do it. I myself would do it if we could talk privately, but as I've seen in other image editing tutorials, you don't seem to appreciate the help I've provided.
If you had visited my profile, you would have noticed that I myself created modifications to access things in RM2K that were previously impossible through events.
I only replied because you
mentioned me
that way, as if I were dictating some rule, when in fact I was just trying to help you, explaining why nobody would create that kind of modification on the official forum and risk being banned. If it were possible to post multiple patches here, I think people would have done it since 2015.
Good lucky
